question: How are findings adjudicated when >=2 panel lanes vote stands-modified?
ruling: Verdict MODIFIED. In finding-space, a stands-modified vote asserts the defect is real in substance but overframed (the underlying content is correct in substance and needs tightening, not wholesale correction). When >=2 of 3 lanes agree on that pole, the panel has a 2-of-3 agreement under the same tally philosophy as '>=2 refute kills'; the finding is adopted in its tightened framing and the fix routes to P3 as a tightening item. Applies to patterns 2xSM+refuted, 2xSM+stands, and 3xSM. 1-1-1 splits remain individually adjudicated.
precedent: adjudicate_tally.py >=2-of-3 rule; check_ledger inv2 recognizes DISMISSED/MODIFIED/ESCALATE as the non-UPHELD verdicts.
scope: P2 pass over the 296-escalate queue only; staged via scripts/s9/adjudicate_sm.py with full tally provenance.
